payload.summary: Greptile and CI on PR #102 (MAR-2919): opt-in CLI output needs test isolation, coverage of both error branches and the exact opt-in value, and must not change published help text.
lessons: CLI --help output is part of the published compatibility oracle; document new options or environment variables in the README and contract instead of changing help text.
Strip developer-exported debug variables in scripts/test-ci.ts so tests that parse stderr as one JSON value stay deterministic; diagnostic tests set the variable explicitly.
Test opt-in diagnostics on the unexpected-error branch as well as EncephalonError, and prove a non-exact value such as true leaves output unchanged.
Troubleshooting advice to rerun a command must defer to recovery actions when the failed command may already have committed work.
verification: Run check:package and check:compatibility (or wait for the release-equivalent CI job) before pushing any CLI surface change.
